name: Broiled Pork Chop with Green Beans, Peppers, Tahini Yogurt & Almonds

instructions.primary_message: Preheat the broiler to high and position rack about 6 inches from the top.
Place pork chops on a broiler pan and season both sides with salt and pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 pork chops, bone-in
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place pan in the oven. Broil, flipping halfway through, until chops are no longer pink in the center and are browned at the edges, 12-14 minutes. Remove from oven and let rest for 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, preheat a large pot over medium heat.
While the pot heats up, place yogurt, tahini, vinegar, and salt in a small bowl. Stir to combine and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ cups plain Greek yogurt
⅓ cup tahini
3 tbsp white wine vinegar
½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Once the pot is hot, add almonds and cook, stirring frequently, until golden and toasted, about 5 minutes. Transfer to a plate and set aside. (Reserve pot for later use.)
Wash, dry, and trim green beans; place in a large bowl.
Wash, dry, trim, and seed bell peppers, then slice lengthwise into thin strips. Add to the bowl with the green beans.
Return the pot to high heat, add oil, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggies, salt, and pepper; cook, stirring occasionally, until blistered and tender, 6-7 minutes. Remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide chops and tahini yogurt between plates; top yogurt with veggies and almonds. Enjoy!
